definitions.explanation: a written document specifying goods or services to be purchased

examples.japanese: {注文書|ちゅうもんしょ}を{送|おく}る。
{注文書|ちゅうもんしょ}に{必要事項|ひつようじこう}を{記入|きにゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please fill in the required information on the order form.

examples.japanese: {注文書|ちゅうもんしょ}を{受|う}け{取|と}り{次第|しだい}、{発送|はっそう}します。
examples.english: We will ship as soon as we receive the order form.

notes:
RELATED TERMS:
- {発注書|はっちゅうしょ} (purchase order - more formal business term)
- {注文|ちゅうもん} (order)
- {見積書|みつもりしょ} (quotation/estimate)
- {請求書|せいきゅうしょ} (invoice)
- {納品書|のうひんしょ} (delivery slip)
